notes.title: Danger in Pompeii is finally out after two years of hard work!!
notes.notes:
[p]It’s finally here. After almost two years of hard work, very long playtest sessions and chasing mysterious bugs — without ever losing the passion — [i][b]Danger in Pompeii[/b][/i] is now live on Steam![/p][p]We created this game as an [b]educative adventure set during the final day of Pompeii[/b] — a story-driven journey where you wander through the streets of the ancient city, help friends and neighbors solve mysteries before escaping the eruption. And today, we’re thrilled to finally share it with you.[/p][p][/p][h3]It's a long road 'til the release[/h3][p]When we first started working on [i]Danger in Pompeii[/i], we had no clue of how far this project would take us — historically and technically. We had a LOT of challenges to go through - and we learned so much through the whole process of releasing this first game on Steam![/p][p]We received so much positive feedback and encouraging messages, not to mention the sharp eyes of people passionated by history helpng us correct details until the end. This adventure has been a blast and we truly mean it when we say: [b]thank you[/b] [/p][p][/p][h3]A unique educational collaboration[/h3][p]What makes [i]Danger in Pompeii[/i] truly special is that we developed it in collaboration with a school — more than [b]fifty students[/b] took part in the creative process under the supervision of their teachers![/p][p]Some contributed to [b]concept art, others helped us elaborate game design elements[/b], and one even [b]composed the entire soundtrack[/b] of the game! This collaboration helped us shape a game that is truly both fresh and historically accurate, and we’re incredibly proud of the result.[/p][p][/p][h3]What’s next?[/h3][p]Now the game is in your hands. If you come across any bugs, issues, or simply want to share feedback or impressions, please don’t hesitate to leave a review or to post on the Community Hub — we’ll be watching closely, and we’re already planning a few small post-launch updates.[/p][p][/p][h3]Thank you again — and enjoy the journey[/h3][p]Thank you for your messages and your energy. We can’t wait to see your feedbacl and your thoughts on our game.[/p][p]Now go roam the roman streets and solve puzzles... time is short in Pompeii. ⌛[/p][p]Enjoy the game,
[b]— [/b]DNA Studios[/p]

notes.title: 🌋DANGER IN POMPEII🌋Price Announcement
notes.notes: [p]Get ready to explore the streets of ancient Pompeii, solve story-driven puzzles, and face the eruption of Mount Vesuvius in a hand-drawn adventure inspired by real historical sources. The game was led by a History expert from Institut Le Rosey and shaped by the creativity of its students - bringing the past to life through play.[/p][p]At its core, [b][i]Danger in Pompeii[/i][/b] is more than just a game, it’s an educational adventure designed to make learning accessible and engaging. The full version will be available for just [b]$4.99 on Steam[/b], and thanks to the contribution of the Fondation Le Rosey, [b]free for schools and on mobile platforms[/b], as part of the game’s mission to share educational content with as many people as possible.[/p][p]The demo remains available on Steam until 18th of July.[/p]

notes.title: 🌋Danger in Pompeii🌋ERUPTION DATE is set!
notes.notes:
[h2]📅July 25th !📅[/h2][p][/p][p]Steam Next Fest was a blast, thank you for all the love and positive feedback on the demo! We've seen how much people enjoy educational content mixed with adventures, we got 1'000 wishlists and had the opportunity to get in touch with tons of lovely people, so again, thank you![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45610445/444442cd92966840d79bb3d0b967451d51856226.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]And now, it's time for us to work on the release of the game. So here we are, the eruption date is set - and there's no coming back! [/p][p]With the full content, you'll be able to explore way more content and locations! You always wanted to see the Great Theater? The luxurious Roman baths? The games of the arena?[/p][p]We have those. And way more! Like an eruption. That's pretty cool, no? Wait. No. It's not.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45610445/5657837992326d46fe9e0531b8466ea07a2fcd3f.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Can't wait to try it out? [/h3][p]Don't worry, the demo is still available for everyone, give it a try! And if you enjoy wandering through Pompeii, don't forget to give us a wishlist and leave a feedback![/p][p][/p][p]Cheers!
DNA Studios[/p]

notes.title: 🧩 Can You Guess Where in Pompeii?
notes.notes:
[p]We wanted to take a moment to say [b]THANK YOU[/b] to all of you who’ve wishlisted [i]Danger in Pompeii[/i] or played the demo so far. Your support means everything during this Next Fest 💛[/p][p]But we’re not done yet! The demo is still live until [b]June 16th[/b], so if you haven’t played it—or want to share it with friends—now’s the time![/p][p]To celebrate, we’ve made something a little different:
🎯 A custom [b]GeoGuessr quiz[/b] where you have to match in-game screenshots from [i]Danger in Pompeii[/i] with [b]real locations[/b] in the ancient city on Google Street view.[/p][p]It’s our fun way to show just how faithfully we recreated Pompeii, even in a hand-drawn 2D cartoon style.[/p][p]Try the quiz, share your score, and see how well [i]you[/i] know ancient streets: [/p][p][/p][p]👉  👉  [url="https://www.geoguessr.com/quiz/53911e1c-5697-41f2-9fd2-0683f7ec9f4e?r=683ef446794b26186a9bb141"]https://www.geoguessr.com/quiz/53911e1c-5697-41f2-9fd2-0683f7ec9f4e?r=683ef446794b26186a9bb141[/url][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45610445/a1c8b9e41f8c2755ca103c3650ef6d92347f61c5.png"][/img][/p][p]And if you haven’t already, [b]wishlist the game[/b] on Steam—it helps [i]so much[/i] with visibility, and there's still time to play the demo before the fest ends![/p][p]
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3726430/Danger_in_Pompeii_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Let us know how you did on the quiz!
The DNA Studios Team[/p]

notes.title: 🌋Danger in Pompeii🌋Play the demo NOW!
notes.notes:
[b]Hi everyone! We are so thrilled to share this demo with you, and we hope you'll enjoy wandering through the streets of Pompeii and solve its mysteries![/b]

It's a special project mixing adventure and puzzle mechanics with storytelling. The world and enigmas are based on real historical sources and were created in collaboration with a Pompei expert from the famous Institut le Rosey. Their students even participated by helping to create musics, game designs and so much more...

It's definitely an adventure game first, but we hope you learn something about ancient rome while playing ːsteamhappyː

[b]Try the demo now! and if you like it, add it to your Wishlist! [/b] The Demo will be available only during Steam Next Fest until June 16th!
